text: dsh-yorha-ui 是面向 DSH Web 的 NieR:Automata / YoRHa 工业终端主题插件。它通过 Web 客户端主题服务叠加浅色与深色主题令牌，并挂载一份受插件标记类限定的样式。主要效果包括沙色与炭黑配色、直角无阴影界面、工作区与会话列表的机械风格、编辑器和菜单配色，以及网格纸纹和强调色状态细节。适合希望调整 DSH Web 外观、偏好高对比工业终端视觉的用户。安装使用 DSH Web 插件配置，无需额外密钥或账号。

dsh-yorha-ui gives DSH Web a YoRHa industrial terminal theme. It applies light and dark palette tokens and scoped CSS for square, shadow-free surfaces. The workspace, session list, editor, and menus gain sand, charcoal, and amber styling. No extra key or account is needed.
想把 DSH 网页界面换成工业终端风格。
有没有能给 DSH Web 更换配色和整体外观的主题？
让 DSH 的浅色和深色模式都呈现沙色与炭黑色调。
想让会话列表和工作区看起来像机械风格的战术终端。
DSH Web 能不能把圆角和阴影改成平直硬朗的界面？
我想给 DSH 的编辑器、菜单和代码块统一视觉配色。
Can I give the DSH Web interface a YoRHa-inspired terminal look?
I want a web theme that coordinates DSH light and dark appearances with sand and charcoal colors.
dsh-yorha-ui 的功能「双模式主题令牌」：为 DSH Web 叠加成组的浅色与深色颜色、字体和阴影令牌。插件挂载时由 theme 服务应用，适配当前外观模式。
dsh-yorha-ui 的功能「硬边几何样式」：将界面圆角、阴影和背景模糊改为直角平面效果，并以插件标记类限定作用范围。插件卸载清理时会移除样式和标记。
dsh-yorha-ui 的功能「工作区与会话导航外观」：为侧栏、项目行和会话行增加分隔线、网格纹理和琥珀色选中状态，呈现机械式导航视觉。
dsh-yorha-ui 的功能「减少动态效果适配」：在用户系统偏好减少动态效果时，关闭项目展开和会话选中的短暂动画效果。

A **NieR:Automata / YoRHa-inspired industrial terminal theme** for DeepSeek Harness Web.

dsh-yorha-ui README · dsh-yorha-ui：It reshapes the DSH Web workspace, session list, composer, and overlays with sand-toned paper, charcoal structural lines, and amber status markers while preserving the original interactions and light/dark appearance modes.

> Theme preview: a structured representation of the plugin's actual visual rules. It contains no additional animation or game assets.

dsh-yorha-ui README · Features：- Sand and charcoal palettes that follow the DSH appearance mode
- Square geometry, hard borders, and shadow-free industrial surfaces
- YoRHa-style workspace navigation with project headers, mechanical rails, and a reverse-video active session
- A 32px registration grid, subtle paper texture, and segmented system rail
- Consistent colors for the composer, menus, dialogs, code blocks, and syntax highlighting
- A clickable `YoRHa // TACTICAL INTERFACE 11945` repository link in the lower-right corner
- Short, one-shot selection and expansion feedback; no continuous page animation
- Reduced-motion support, with no runtime CDN or image dependencies
- Theme-token overrides that survive DSH theme repaints

dsh-yorha-ui README · Install from npm (stable release)：Install the current stable release from npm:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add -w dsh-yorha-ui
```

Without a globally installed `dsh` command:

```powershell
npx.cmd --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest plugin --profile web add -w dsh-yorha-ui
```

dsh-yorha-ui README · Install from source：```powershell
git clone https://github.com/MrmoLabs/dsh-yorha-ui.git
cd dsh-yorha-ui
pnpm install
pnpm run build

Restart DSH Web after installation, then refresh `http://127.0.0.1:3080`.

dsh-yorha-ui README · Update and uninstall：Update the npm release:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web update -w dsh-yorha-ui
```

Uninstall the plugin:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove -w dsh-yorha-ui
```

If you previously installed a local development link, remove that link before installing `dsh-yorha-ui`.

dsh-yorha-ui README · Development and verification：Node.js 22 or later is required.

```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm run check
pnpm test
npm.cmd pack --dry-run

The repository pins pnpm 10 through `packageManager`; Corepack-enabled environments will select the matching version automatically. `pnpm test` rebuilds the package before running the regression suite.

To inspect the selection and expansion feedback without changing a DSH installation, build the package and run the local preview:

dsh-yorha-ui README · Development and verification：```powershell
node scripts/build.mjs
node scripts/serve-motion-preview.mjs
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:4173/` and click the project and session rows. The preview loads the actual client bundle, but its surrounding layout is illustrative.

Build output is written to `dist/`:

- `dist/index.js`: DSH host entry
- `dist/client.js`: self-registering browser bundle with no relative runtime dependencies

dsh-yorha-ui README · Automated releases：The repository contains two GitHub Actions workflows:

- `CI` installs dependencies, type-checks, runs regression tests, rebuilds, and verifies the package on every push to `main` and every pull request.
- `Release` verifies that a pushed `v*` tag matches the `package.json` version, runs the same checks and regression tests, creates a GitHub Release with the `.tgz` archive attached, and publishes the same archive through npm Trusted Publishing.

dsh-yorha-ui README · Project scope：`src/client.ts` contains the current theme implementation. `src/prompt`, `src/tools`, `src/templates`, `src/theme/tokens.css`, and `src/types.ts` are early agent-facing plugin drafts. They are retained as design references and are not included in the current build.

dsh-yorha-ui README · Disclaimer：This is an unofficial community theme. It is not affiliated with Square Enix, PlatinumGames, or the NieR franchise rights holders, and it contains no original game assets.

它将 DSH Web 的工作区、会话列表、编辑器和浮层统一为沙色纸张、炭黑结构线与琥珀色状态标记，同时保留浅色/深色模式和原有交互逻辑。

> Theme preview：展示的是插件实际视觉规则的结构化预览，不包含额外动画或游戏素材。

dsh-yorha-ui README · 特性：- 沙色与炭黑双主题，跟随 DSH 外观模式切换
- 全局直角几何、硬边框和无阴影工业界面
- 经典 YoRHa 风格工作区导航：项目标题、机械导轨、反色视频选中态
- 32px 注册网格、轻量纸张纹理、顶部系统状态轨
- 编辑器、菜单、对话框、代码块和语法高亮统一配色
- 右下角 `YoRHa // TACTICAL INTERFACE 11945` 可直接打开源码仓库
- 选中会话与展开项目时提供短促的一次性反馈，无持续页面动画
- 支持减少动态效果设置，无运行时 CDN 或图片依赖
- 通过 DSH 的主题服务叠加令牌，可在主题重绘后保持生效
